scope: Query-first replication of the public NEAR investor-relations feeds. No new IR metrics embedded in the website.
authentication: Neither endpoint required credentials in the captured requests or successful Dune executions.

Revenue: All-time, YTD and 30-day fees and revenue in source NEAR-equivalent units
Daily Intents fees and protocol fees
Daily captured Intents revenue and provider-classified protocol fee burn
Daily emissions, cumulative fees/revenue and revenue-to-emissions ratio
Intents: Token and blockchain composition over the last 30 available completed dates
Base chain: Daily active accounts, monthly active accounts and 30-day new accounts
Token: Reported price, market capitalization, circulating, total and locked supply KPIs
Capital context: Existing standard-API TVL and stablecoin histories
Existing tracked-product and stablecoin composition charts

not_established_by_these_APIs: Independent verification of real people, account ownership or the provider's unique-user methodology
Executed token purchases, burns or distributable tokenholder earnings inferred from revenue classifications
Live measured TPS capacity, finality, shard and AI-agent counts from the Products tab
Automatic discovery of every current DeFi product through one Dune LiveFetch call: the tested /protocols response exceeded Dune's 4 MiB limit
An availability or schema-stability contract for the public custom IR endpoints
source_discrepancies: Captured totalSwaps was 34,869,884 while cumulativeSwaps was 37,643,742. Both are retained, not forced to agree.
IR native transactions for 4 November were 706,690 versus 706,698 in the separate native Dune extraction.
Revenue histories ended 3 November; native and token histories ended 4 November, despite a 5 November source update timestamp.
Channel fees, gross fees and revenue-wallet receipts use different scopes and windows. They must not be substituted for one another.
refresh: Rerunning the Python analysis uses frozen, hashed JSON snapshots. Executing the saved Dune SQL refreshes the public source independently; new source snapshots and execution captures need a new validation record.
validation: Source hashes, parallel date/value arrays, finite values, unique dates/series, fee/revenue KPI reconciliation, source supply identity, 41 executed scorecard values, daily execution samples, 25 visible composition rows and the complete 18-row wallet/channel capture. No independent onchain audit claimed.
